note: On profile he is the closest match in this batch to the stated ICP: 45, runs his own business, already retains a business coach, and articulates good-to-great better than the ICP quote itself does — 'you're either evolving or you're kind of slipping' and 'I want to be the absolute best version of myself.' At 198 lb training three to four days a week on whole foods he clears the deconditioned exclusion comfortably. He misses neglected_health for the same reason Kevin Vibert does: his health is not the neglected corner, it is the thing he has been working on for two years. Income is recorded as a miss because he declined at $1,000 a month and bought at $1,000 for six, though the honest reading is that his constraint was hours rather than dollars — 'it's not that the value isn't there, it's like I'm not able to actually receive all the value.' That distinction matters for the ICP: the criteria screen for capacity to pay and say nothing about capacity to participate, and capacity to participate is what lost the $6,000 here.
